title: Fanciful icons on a simple grainy gradient
question: The background is now a simple grainy gradient in two tones: beige to a darker beige by day, grey to a darker grey at night. Four icon sets with much more fantasy; each card shows the board by day, the drawer at night, and the set. Pick one, or steer (for example: Papiers colorés with the Bonbons' colours).

options.label: Papiers colorés
options.lineage: Matisse cut-outs, like the collection emblems: coloured paper pieces cut with scissors
options.thesis: Every icon is a little collage of coloured paper: a blue bell with a yellow clapper, a green bin with a pink lid, a pencil with its pink eraser, sliders with yellow and pink knobs.
materials: an ink key piece for legibility
options.viewport: Board by day with collage icons in the search bar, the checklists and the bottom bar; the drawer at night with the same pieces brightened.
options.risk: Colour everywhere competes with the notes' own colours; each icon needs a dark key piece to stay readable at 24px.
options.case: The most Carnet: the icons speak the emblems' cut-paper language, and nobody else draws icons like this.

options.label: Bonbons
options.lineage: Candy and inflated toys: puffy, glossy, pastel
options.thesis: Chunky, puffy shapes in candy colours, lit from the top left with a glint: a butter-yellow bell, a mint bin with a pink lid, a lilac magnifier.
materials: a white glint on every shape
options.viewport: Board by day with puffy candy icons; the drawer at night where they glow like sweets.
options.risk: 3D icons are a known trend, and pastels get pale on the beige ground at small sizes.
options.case: The most fun to touch: every tap lands on a sweet.

options.label: Feutre & fluo
options.lineage: A bullet journal: black felt-tip doodles over quick highlighter swipes
options.thesis: Each icon is a felt-tip doodle drawn over a swipe of yellow, pink, green or blue highlighter, as if you had marked up your own carnet.
options.viewport: Board by day with doodled icons and highlighter swipes; the drawer at night with softer swipes.
options.risk: Hand-drawn can tip into scrappy; the swipes need to stay short and consistent.
options.case: Feels written by you, in your own notebook.

options.label: Frimousses
options.lineage: Little characters: the things that keep your stuff smile back
options.thesis: Clean line icons where the objects that hold your things have little faces: the bell, the note, the archive box and the bin smile, the magnifier looks around, the sun in a photo is happy.
options.viewport: Board by day where the photo's sun and the reminder bell smile; the drawer at night where Notes, Rappels, Archives and Corbeille have faces.
options.risk: Can read childish, and a smiling bin is funny once, maybe less the hundredth time.
options.case: Instant affection: the app has a personality.
